description_en: Grants batch permissions for data portal menus. Already authorized menus are automatically skipped
description_zh: 数据门户菜单的批量授权，已经授权的会自动略过
name: AuthorizeMenu

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data portal
parameters.name: data_portal_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the leaf node menus in the data portal. You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh:
数据门户的叶子节点菜单ID。
支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为100
parameters.name: menu_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the user groups. You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 200 IDs at a time. You must specify at least one of UserGroupIds and UserIds
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID列表。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为200
UserGroupIds和UserIds不能同时为空
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the users. These are Quick BI user IDs, not Alibaba Cloud UIDs. You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 200 IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID列表。此处为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为200
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en:
The permissions to grant for the menus. Valid values:

1: View.
3: View and export. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
授权菜单的权限。取值范围：

1：查看
3：查看+导出（默认）
parameters.name: auth_points_value

Result.description_en: The number of menus that are successfully authorized

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
